notes.vo: Penydarren, Merthyr and Abercynon were respelled in the TTS text only, for pronunciation.
gaps: There is no period image of the 1804 run itself. Those beats use photos of the working Penydarren replica (captioned as a replica, 6 beats), modern photos of the old tramroad route, an 1811 ironworks view, and maps.
The Rainhill print and the 1811 ironworks view are small originals, so their push-ins are kept gentle.
No picture is AI-generated or illustrated; the only drawn graphics are maps, calendars and type cards.
notes.review: Rebuilt 2026-10-03 on real images (owner's Episode 2 notes): no cartoon scenes, a running time bar, and the plain-talk script.
